profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer
profile.summary: Full-stack developer with 8+ years of experience building enterprise web applications end to end, from frontend and backend to database design and optimization, across retail, e-commerce, logistics, enterprise software, and capital markets technology.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Enterprise platforms and AI automation for Samsung affiliates across U.S. entities.

AP AI Validation Platform (delivered to Samsung Electronics)

• Built an AP validation platform that checks vendor invoices and travel expenses against company policy before payment, replacing a process that took 6 people.
• Sole engineer end-to-end: architecture, auth, security, backend (Next.js/PostgreSQL), frontend, CI/CD — built through Claude Code, agents on scoped tasks in parallel, design and code review kept hands-on.
• Wired into Samsung's company-wide approval workflow as the AI first-pass reviewer ahead of every human approval.
• Parses receipts and invoices in any format with combined text + vision passes; accuracy comes from prompt design and validation logic, not the model alone.
• Ran commercial and self-hosted models (Gemini; Qwen 3.5 at 32B/122B), tuning per tier: heavier guards and simpler prompts for smaller models, deeper reasoning as models improved.
• Cut LLM cost and latency with prompt caching and sharding at runtime, lean agent context and cheaper models in the dev loop.
• Feedback loop learns from each approver's decision, improving edge cases without retraining.
• Delivered batch jobs, reporting, a plain-language AI assistant, and REST APIs; GitHub Actions CI/CD with Docker, deployed over SSH.

Workplace Reservation Platform (CR2)

• Multi-tenant room/desk reservation platform (React + Spring Boot, MySQL) across 5 affiliates, 10+ buildings, hundreds of rooms.
• Integrated 22Miles digital signage, Embrava desk sensors, and room-side panels for real-time status and on-site booking.
• Reusable Storybook component library for the enterprise design system; production deployments on Linux and Windows.

SmartSpending & TEMS

• Built SmartSpending (Vue.js + Spring Boot), forecasting and budget tracking for executive financial visibility.
• Maintained and extended TEMS (AngularJS + Spring), device ordering and billing across 5 affiliates.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed enterprise automation and financial data processing systems for global manufacturing operations.

• Built a fully automated Proof of Delivery (POD) acquisition system using Python and Selenium, integrating Google Drive, carrier portals, and internal databases — 100% processing accuracy with automated monitoring and alerts.
• Developed Oracle PL/SQL procedures for AP/AR and accrual processing across three manufacturing entities in Mexico, handling edge cases including freight, tax, and cross-border fees.
• Extended a Java-based internal framework (DevOn) with new features and menus per business requirements.
• Contributed to CI/CD pipeline improvements using Jenkins.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and maintained enterprise retail systems integrating mobile, hardware, and backend infrastructure.

• Built an enterprise barcode scanning app using React JS and Swift (iOS Native SDK) with Zebra Bluetooth printer integration.
• Developed and deployed digital shelf labeling and order processing systems using Electronic Shelf Label (ESL) and iOS devices.
• Maintained enterprise web applications (Ext JS / React frontend + Java Spring backend) and MS SQL databases.
• Managed mobile device fleet via Apple MDM, Jamf, and Cisco Meraki.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed the integration between ChannelAdvisor and the in-house ERP, syncing products, inventory, and orders across Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Target and other marketplaces.

• Designed and built the ChannelAdvisor–ERP integration (Java Spring) that kept product info, prices, and inventory levels in sync with Amazon, eBay, Walmart, and Target.
• Automated order fulfillment end to end, pulling marketplace orders into the ERP and sending shipment tracking and order cancellations back to each channel.
• Developed Python-based ERP sync tools for automated product data management across partner systems.
• Built a PHP/JavaScript Amazon SEO platform to improve product visibility and keyword coverage.
• Automated Magento RMA label generation via UPS API.
• Designed a React + FTP-based job management system for product image processing workflows.

• Conducted GPS-based AR simulations and embedded safety system support

projects.title: AI Drawing Inspection System (2026)
projects.description:
AI tool that reviews CAD drawings for a manufacturing client. Pulls dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, and material data out of Solid Edge files (.par/.psm/.dft) and checks them against design standards, flagging missing or inconsistent callouts for the designer.

• Pairs structured data from the Solid Edge API with multimodal LLM analysis of the rendered drawing, so it catches both data-level and visual problems; results served through an API the plugin calls.
• Similar-drawing search over past drawings, plus a labeling screen that logs each result with the reviewer's correction — building a dataset to fine-tune on as cases accumulate.
• Entire stack built solo with Claude Code: agents in parallel on scoped work (scaffolding, tests, migrations), every change reviewed by hand.

projects.title: Dayby — Voice-First Baby-Care Logging App (2026)
projects.description:
Voice-first baby-care logger: a parent speaks one sentence, an LLM structures it into a typed event on a shared family timeline, and the app confirms back by voice. Flutter (iOS-first), FastAPI, and MongoDB.

• Gemini classifies each sentence by intent and extracts fields, validated against the event schema. Users confirm an editable card before any write, and questions are answered only from logged events.
• Modeled events as flexible MongoDB documents (fixed fields on common types, open fields for the rest) and built real-time family sync on change streams pushed over WebSocket, running a single-node replica set for the oplog.
